notes.title: Dev Update - Build 0.1.3 Update & New Features Video!
notes.content:
[p][b]🛠️ Build 0.1.3 is LIVE — New Features + Balance Tweaks![/b][/p][p]Development continues with a major update to the backend of survival systems. A fresh build just landed for all backers, packed with new content and gameplay improvements! 🎉 Check out the new overview video, or skim the highlights below:[/p][p]• 🏕️ [b]Interior Campsites[/b] – Sleep indoors for better recovery
• ☕ [b]Cooking & Boiling[/b] – Brew tea, coffee, and purify water
• 🩸 [b]Blood Infection[/b] – A dangerous new affliction to treat… or ignore at your own risk
• 🍄 [b]New Items[/b] – Reishi mushrooms, antiseptic, antibiotics, and more
• 📊 [b]Hunger/Thirst Rebalance[/b] – Smoother survival flow[/p][p][b]Coming soon:[/b] [i]Base Building: Part 1[/i] — a major new feature that kicks off player-built shelters and custom layouts. 🔨🏚️ Keep an eye out!

[/p][previewyoutube="7JGPfpJPLTc;full"][/previewyoutube][p] 🔹 The demo Build 0.1.3 is currently available to existing backers and anyone else who backs us on indiegogo can play now.  We do updates to the build every few months leading up to our upcoming steam release.  Check us out on Indiegogo if you're interested! 🚀  [url="https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/as-one-we-survive/x/36104042#/"] AOWS On Indiegogo [/url]   

Stay tuned for more updates!  Thanks for all the support.  [/p]

notes.title: Dev Update & Build 0.1.2 Trailer!
notes.content:
Survivors, our latest dev update is here—along with a brand-new trailer! 🎬

We've been hard at work refining core gameplay! Our latest backer demo update (0.1.2) introduces melee combat 🥊, an improved gear screen ⚙️ for shoulder-slotting weapons, roaming wolf packs 🐺, sleeping in beds 🛏️, and more! Whether you're fighting bandits, managing gear, or securing a safe place to rest, survival is getting deeper.

We've been hard at work on the next update and I can't wait to share more soon! 

[previewyoutube=uwLIBtW8yA0;full][/previewyoutube]

🔹 The demo Build 0.1.2 is currently available to existing backers and anyone else who backs us on indiegogo can play now.  We do updates to the build every month or two leading up to our upcoming steam release.

Check us out on Indiegogo if you're interseted! 🚀  [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/as-one-we-survive/x/36104042#/] AOWS On Indiegogo [/url] 

Stay tuned for more updates later this month!  Thanks for all the support.

notes.title: Upcoming Kickstarter
notes.content:
Welcome survivors! We're thrilled to have your support as we work towards our Early Access release. As a small indie studio, we have limited resources but an unwavering commitment to delivering a high-quality product. That's why we've decided to launch a Kickstarter campaign in the coming months to help us achieve our goals.

By reaching our crowdfunding target, we'll be able to bring 'As One We Survive' to Early Access sooner, with greater polish and fewer bugs. We're also excited to offer our backers exclusive rewards, including access to backer demos and private testing, to thank them for their support and help us build a vibrant community.

Please follow our Steam page and sign up for our mailing list on our website to stay updated on our progress, including the release of our new trailer, gameplay video, and Kickstarter campaign. We're dedicated to creating the best possible first impression for our players, and we hope you'll join us on this journey.

[url=https://wesurvive-game.com/]wesurvive-game.com[/url]
